title: Juan M NDE 4530
content: I was at home with my wife, and for several days I had been anxious about problems to do with work, being a very nervous type of person. Because of the magnitude of the problem on that day, I fell on the floor in the bedroom, hitting my head first against the frame of a parked bicycle, and then against the floor. I remember seeing myself in a place where everything was light. I did not look behind me but I noticed that the light shone on everything around me. I could not differentiate between the floor and the ceiling, that is, everything was light, a very bright light, strange but not uncomfortable. I did not know how I had come to be in this place, but it has always seemed to me that I came there at incredible speed, as if I had been through a tunnel or passageway at immense velocity, and ended up there, but this is just a feeling, as I could not see any passageway or tunnel. While I was in this place of light, in the background were visible some sort of dark stains, which kept getting closer, and I began to recognize the silhouettes of three persons, two men and a woman. They did not have complete bodies. The woman was in front. While they came closer, I began to hear shouts and cries. When the silhouettes were very close, I think that we spoke. Although this is not very clear, and it is just then that I began to recognize the shouting and moaning, which came from my wife who was pleading for me to get up, to wake up, and it is after this that I think I came back the same way I went. Then I came to, standing up in my wife's arms, telling her that everything was okay, that it had all been just a scare.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt he arrived at incredible speed, 'as if I had been through a tunnel or passageway at immense velocity,' but he could not see any tunnel/passageway.

arrival.other_being_detail: Three silhouettes (two men and a woman) without complete bodies; the woman was in front.

environment.environment_other_detail: Everything was light; could not differentiate floor from ceiling; very bright light; 'strange but not uncomfortable.' Dark stains in the background that came closer.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He believed he 'came back the same way I went' after recognizing his wife's shouts.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell in bedroom, hit head on bicycle frame and then the floor.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Tunnel/passage was only a felt sense (no tunnel seen). Three human silhouettes approached. Return occurred after hearing/recognizing wife's cries.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate arrival into all-encompassing light; only later a felt sense that he had traveled rapidly as if through a tunnel; then silhouettes; then return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He initially thought he spoke with the silhouettes, but then recognized the 'shouts and moaning' as his wife's pleas to wake up, seemingly blending into the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could not differentiate between the floor and the ceiling, that is, everything was light, a very bright light, strange but not uncomfortable.”
